Callout.Name: Near Drowning
Callout.Message: Person pulled from the water, not breathing.
Callout.Advisory: Bystanders started compressions, water still in the lungs.

Script.Line: The current took me sideways. I could not get back in.
Somebody went in after me. I want to know who it was.
I saw the light on the water and then I saw nothing for a while.

Lines.Approach: Pulled out of the water and somebody is doing compressions on them. Do not stop until you have to.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
